The prior audit records 174 absent main paths: 101 exact blobs elsewhere and 73 not found as loose blobs in either inspected main tree. The latter include 27 alignment checkpoint/control JSON paths and 46 additional-decoder release documentation/checkpoint/source-capsule paths; external/compressed custody and provenance remain unverified by this merge.
Five historical changed source/plan/test paths require semantic and current-API review; old proof, qualification or training receipts do not establish current execution correctness.
A blanket ours merge would falsely imply content integration. Preserve refs, describe exceptions, and port only reviewed unique contributions.
